# PM006: story-too-large

| since | 2.0.0 |

A story is larger than `[pm] max_story_points`.

INVEST asks for a small story; one above the limit cannot finish in a cycle.

## Remedy

Split the story, or raise `[pm] max_story_points` in `frob.toml`.

## Examples

### PM006 story size / A story at the limit is clean #1 (line 8) (clean)

```text
story a points=8
```

### PM006 story size / A story over the limit fires #2 (line 14) (fire)

```text
story a points=13
```

### PM006 story size / An unsized story is clean #3 (line 20) (clean)

```text
story a
```

### PM006 story size / A raised limit lets it through #4 (line 26) (clean)

```text
max_story_points 13
story a points=13
```

### PM006 story size / A limit of zero is off #5 (line 33) (clean)

```text
max_story_points 0
story a points=13
```
